name: Coffee-Entrepreneurship
subtitle: Entrepreneurship & Sustainable Value
description: Entrepreneurial experience in the coffee sector provides a living laboratory where business practice, sustainability, innovation, and community engagement converge—connecting firsthand entrepreneurial experience with broader research on SME innovation and sustainable entrepreneurial ecosystems.
academicParallel: The experience of building and developing coffee ventures provides an empirical foundation for examining how SMEs transform constraints into capabilities, capabilities into innovation, and innovation into sustainable value within emerging entrepreneurial ecosystems.
